records.climate: wet windward slopes with rain shadows inside calderas
records.substrate: Porous basalt and ash loam on old caldera terraces
records.habitat_sequence: Vent exclusions → scrub apron → managed ash orchard → cool riparian forest
records.seasonal_cycle: Wet ash compacts in renewal; dry growth season raises dust; harvest pruning opens firebreaks; cold rain increases steam
records.land_use_loop: Ash orchard compost and refractory-clay extraction share settling ponds
records.pressure: Dumping seals burrow outlets; nesting loss reduces soil mixing
records.migration: Slag-backed burrowers move laterally between cooled terraces, never through active vents
records.recovery: Clear drainage and cap dumping before reseeding; no instant forest growth
records.foundation_ecology: Heat-tolerant scrub occupies cooled terraces; burrowers disperse mineral salts and nest beyond active vents. Slag-backed burrowers become hostile when dumping blocks nesting channels, creating a sanitation conflict rather than an evil species.

records.climate: cold alpine with seasonal melt and whiteouts
records.substrate: Rock-founded alpine valleys, moraine gravel, peat-free thin soil
records.habitat_sequence: Permanent ice → scree/lichen → dwarf shrub → sheltered conifer margin
records.seasonal_cycle: Melt releases water in renewal; short growth is forage-rich; harvest stores fungi; cold season closes optional high trails
records.land_use_loop: Warm-core fungus rooms use imported substrate and measured ventilation
records.pressure: Heavy traffic narrows grazer thaw-margin passage
records.migration: Rime-antler grazers follow receding snowline; predators follow at a separate lower-density band
records.recovery: Reopen a marked corridor and wait a season step; frost casting cannot mint preserved food
records.foundation_ecology: Lichen and sheltered fungi feed rime-antler grazers that browse thaw margins. Seasonal migration signals changing snowpack; predators approach towns when sealed roads interrupt that movement, not because frost creatures are inherently cruel.

records.substrate: Ridge scree and shallow turf, water collected below saddles
records.habitat_sequence: Exposed lightning ridge → rocky pasture → sheltered garden → basin road
records.seasonal_cycle: Renewal icing; growth convective storms; harvest crosswinds; cold snow and rime
records.land_use_loop: Pasture, kite nesting sleeves and insulator workshops share ridge access
records.pressure: Discharge hardware and nest removal reduce kite warning behavior
records.migration: Copper-wing kites track uplift bands outside grounded work corridors
records.recovery: Restore sleeves and lower work disturbance during breeding windows
records.foundation_ecology: Copper-wing kites exploit rising air and roost outside discharge zones. Protective nesting sleeves reduce outages; indiscriminate pest removal harms a species that also warns crews of unstable air currents.

records.climate: warm maritime, seasonal rain and storm surge
records.substrate: Alluvial silt, brackish mud, porous limestone refuge terraces
records.habitat_sequence: Fresh distributary → reed nursery → brackish flats → coastal reef
records.seasonal_cycle: Renewal rain raises freshwater flow; growth marine storms; harvest saline intrusion; cold calmer fishing windows
records.land_use_loop: Aquaculture respects nursery closures; grazer husbandry keeps small channels open
records.pressure: Overgrazing strips banks; total exclusion silts channels
records.migration: Reedback grazers shift between dry hummocks; juvenile fish remain in shallow cover
records.recovery: Alternating grazing lanes and sediment removal restore nursery band
records.foundation_ecology: Reedback grazers keep channels open and shelter fish nurseries. Overgrazing or exclusion damages habitat differently, giving husbandry and fishing meaningful seasonal responsibilities beyond harvesting a decorative coastal biome.

records.climate: wet western faces, dry eastern lee and flash-flooding canyon bottoms
records.substrate: Fractured ridge stone, thin terrace soils, sheltered cave substrate
records.habitat_sequence: Wet western shoulder → divide → dry eastern terrace → flash-flood canyon
records.seasonal_cycle: Renewal runoff scours gullies; growth lee drought; harvest survey; cold freeze-thaw rockfall
records.land_use_loop: Ventilated cave fungi and stepped gardens trade water against mine access
records.pressure: Machinery vibration drives resonance moles from aerating thin soils
records.migration: Moles reroute under low-vibration berms; no persistent tunneling physics
records.recovery: Pause noisy extraction windows, repair ventilation, stabilize terrace drains
records.foundation_ecology: Resonance moles aerate thin soils and react to machinery vibrations. Cave fungi support food production but depend on ventilation and waste management, preventing the underground realm from becoming a consequence-free pantry.

records.climate: gusty upland with sheltered garden microclimates
records.substrate: Cliff crevice soils and pocket gardens behind wind baffles
records.habitat_sequence: Wind edge → nesting fissure → lee orchard → lower reed meadow
records.seasonal_cycle: Renewal breeding shelter; growth gust fronts; harvest seed dispersal; cold low cloud
records.land_use_loop: Sail weaving, reed cutting and garden tending rotate cliff access
records.pressure: Gliders crossing breeding paths lower nesting capacity
records.migration: Sail-feather climbers move along fissure shelves and carry seeds
records.recovery: Seasonal flight detour and untouched seed strips restore occupancy
records.foundation_ecology: Sail-feather climbers nest in sheltered cracks and spread cliff plants on their plumage. Glider traffic disturbs breeding paths; seasonal route closures can support husbandry and gathering without making wildlife mere hazards.

records.climate: wet temperate to warm southern forest
records.substrate: Deep woodland humus and ash-enriched riparian soils
records.habitat_sequence: Upper orchard → mixed canopy → browsing glade → floodplain wetwood
records.seasonal_cycle: Renewal fungal bloom; growth shaded moisture; harvest fruit pulse; cold canopy opening
records.land_use_loop: Fruit, fibers, pruning mulch and managed livestock circulate organic matter
records.pressure: Overbrowsing removes saplings while indiscriminate growth closes glades
records.migration: Seed-carrier browsers travel glade links; rootpath harts use tended forage stops
records.recovery: Thin invasive growth, retain deadwood pockets and replant diverse age bands
records.foundation_ecology: Seed-carrier browsers distribute fruit and maintain glades; predators prevent destructive overbrowsing. Rootpath harts are trained animals with welfare and forage needs, not summonable equipment that disappears when inconvenient.

records.climate: humid seasonal floodplain with stagnant-air episodes
records.substrate: Waterlogged mineral silt with alternating fresh and stagnant pools
records.habitat_sequence: Raised lab garden → filter marsh → settling pool → reed buffer
records.seasonal_cycle: Renewal floods spread sediment; growth stagnant heat; harvest filter renewal; cold low biological uptake
records.land_use_loop: Reagent cultivation uses closed vessels and replaceable filter beds
records.pressure: Crawler harvesting increases short-term reagent supply but reduces filtration
records.migration: Filter-shelled crawlers move between connected clean pools, not across contaminated plots
records.recovery: Isolate fictional contaminant ledger first, then rebuild filtration habitat
records.foundation_ecology: Filter-shelled crawlers concentrate minerals and require careful habitat management. Harvesting them for reagents can improve short-term treatment while reducing long-term filtration, giving gatherers ecological choices beyond rarity tiers.

records.climate: moderate continental basin with seasonal fog and summer heat
records.substrate: Basin meadow loam, drained civic gardens, river margins
records.habitat_sequence: Public meadow → orchard belt → urban pollinator patch → night refuge garden
records.seasonal_cycle: Renewal fog and flood pulses; growth heat; harvest hay; cold dormant meadow
records.land_use_loop: Coursers pull clinic carts; meadow rotations feed animals without consuming pollinator refuges
records.pressure: Overbright wards disrupt nocturnal feeding and nearby sleep
records.migration: Prism-backed coursers use meadow corridors; birds shift to low-light garden bands
records.recovery: Dim nonessential wards at night and restore meadow rotation
records.foundation_ecology: Prism-backed coursers graze public meadow belts and pull clinic carts. Urban birds and pollinator gardens support ordinary life, while excessive ward brightness can disrupt nocturnal wildlife and neighboring residents.

records.climate: clear dry intervals, sea wind and coastal fog
records.substrate: Coastal rocky shelf, dry calcareous soil, wind-scoured outcrops
records.habitat_sequence: Stable inland ground → sheltered shrub → thermal cliff → fog shore
records.seasonal_cycle: Renewal sea fog; growth clear dry intervals; harvest wind; cold maritime squalls
records.land_use_loop: Dry gardens and roost monitoring support provisioned scientific outposts
records.pressure: Shifting gravity volumes displace roostlings from thermal columns
records.migration: Ballast-wing roostlings follow stable uplift; they do not forecast exact celestial events
records.recovery: Keep anomalous volumes off roost corridors; restore conventional access
records.foundation_ecology: Ballast-wing roostlings nest around stable thermal updrafts and avoid shifting gravity fields. Their movements warn workers of local anomalies, giving ecology an observational role without claiming animals understand celestial mathematics.

records.climate: cool fog pockets amid drier sheltered slopes
records.substrate: Sheltered dry slope soil, damp caves, fog-collecting rock
records.habitat_sequence: Dry scrub → patchy shade → cave mouth → crowded fixed refuge
records.seasonal_cycle: Renewal fog; growth dry slope heat; harvest longer shade; cold cave damp
records.land_use_loop: Fog-water gardens and careful cave gathering supply fixed public refuges
records.pressure: Excess lighting and sealed corridors push stalkers toward refuge edges
records.migration: Dusk-window stalkers follow physical patchy-light corridors; no dimension travel implied
records.recovery: Restore unbroken habitat strips without concealing public exits
records.foundation_ecology: Dusk-window stalkers hunt along patchy light boundaries and avoid crowded refuges. Habitat corridors remain physical even when an Oath conceals them, allowing ecological study without claiming every shadow is another dimension.

records.climate: seasonal dry heat, cool uplands and flood pulses
records.substrate: Iron-rich scrub soils, alluvial pasture pockets, cool upland stone
records.habitat_sequence: Dry scrub → communal pasture → flood terrace → cool upland rest station
records.seasonal_cycle: Renewal flood pulse; growth heat; harvest forage scarcity; cold upland rest
records.land_use_loop: Herd fiber, food and pack transport require load limits, water and pasture rotation
records.pressure: Overloading packhorns and exhausted pasture reduce welfare band
records.migration: Ironbrush herdbeasts follow seasonal water; redland packhorns travel staffed stages
records.recovery: Rest stock and repair water stops; lifeforce effects do not replace nutrition
records.foundation_ecology: Ironbrush herdbeasts graze scrub and support transport, fiber and food economies. Redland packhorns require careful load management and communal pasture agreements, creating husbandry beyond the covenant's combat identity.

records.climate: dry summers, cool nights and episodic valley fog
records.substrate: Dry valley alluvium, scrub hillside, shaded cultivated courtyards
records.habitat_sequence: Summer-dry hillside → orchard → cool courtyard → fog valley floor
records.seasonal_cycle: Renewal orchard bloom; growth dry heat; harvest cool nights; cold valley fog
records.land_use_loop: Dye plants, textiles and stage carpentry draw on managed gardens and traded wood
records.pressure: Festival footfall fragments fox cover and compacts soil
records.migration: Mirror-mantled foxes use patterned fur through scrub; natural camouflage is not illusion
records.recovery: Rotate festival grounds and restore hedgerow cover with visible true exits
records.foundation_ecology: Mirror-mantled foxes use patterned fur and behavior to evade predators without literally becoming magical holograms. Altered variants require separate concepts, preserving a meaningful distinction between natural camouflage and Oath-driven illusion.

records.climate: seasonal drought with intense rain and flash floods
records.substrate: Steppe loam, gravel fans and flash-flood channels
records.habitat_sequence: Forage steppe → seasonal stream → maintained road → wildlife underpass
records.seasonal_cycle: Renewal brief grass pulse; growth drought; harvest migration; cold hard ground
records.land_use_loop: Roadside grain stores and grazing stops serve long-haul caravans
records.pressure: Fenced highways cut forage routes and intensify local pressure
records.migration: Steppe longrunners cross protected lanes on scheduled seasonal windows
records.recovery: Open crossings, reseed verges, retire event detours after flood recession
records.foundation_ecology: Steppe longrunners migrate along seasonal forage routes that highways can sever. Road crews maintain wildlife crossings, making faster transport answerable to ecological continuity rather than automatically superior to older paths.

records.climate: humid maritime with storm surge and industrial heat islands
records.substrate: Disturbed coastal fill, humid garden pockets, warm service cavities
records.habitat_sequence: Storm berm → industrial service strip → planted buffer → tidal outlet
records.seasonal_cycle: Renewal heavy rain; growth heat island; harvest surge readiness; cold corrosion maintenance
records.land_use_loop: Repair salvage and container gardens share inspected drainage, not waste dumping
records.pressure: Warm scrap cavities attract scavengers; contaminated waste harms useful seed carriers
records.migration: Scrap-nesting scavengers move through planted service buffers
records.recovery: Sort waste, cool safe nesting boxes and restore drainage before planting
records.foundation_ecology: Scrap-nesting scavengers exploit warm service cavities and transport seeds between disturbed sites. Habitat design and waste management can reduce conflict, while indiscriminate extermination removes useful scavenging without fixing the underlying problem.
